abstract: Maintains overland tracked caterpillar convoy capacities and sled payload allocations
system_message:
You are the Heavy traverse coordinator (TRV), responsible for maintaining overland tracked caterpillar convoy capacities, sled payload allocations, and sno-cat track maintenance records for expedition logistics across polar routes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sno-cat track maintenance（FLEET）
information_points.content:
TRV-FLEET-M2B：For the Hercules Dome Deep Skiway Architecture, the overland convoy mobile machine shop workshop maintenance manifest confirms a spare track link inventory of 20 units of reserve crawler track shoes on board.
TRV-FLEET-RKC：For the Skytrain Ice Rise Coastal Hub Architecture, the overland convoy mobile machine shop workshop maintenance manifest verifies a spare track link inventory of 14 units of reserve crawler track shoes on board.
TRV-FLEET-VCP：For the Dome C East Overland Traverse Architecture, the overland convoy mobile machine shop workshop maintenance manifest lists a spare track link inventory of 26 units of reserve crawler track shoes on board.

information_points.title: Maintains overland tracked caterpillar convoy capacities and sled payload allocations（CONVOY）
information_points.content:
TRV-CONVOY-3EA：For the Skytrain Ice Rise Coastal Hub Architecture, the overland traverse voyage plan records a caterpillar traverse payload of 40 t for continental ice route transport of heavy drill components and bulk casing from the coastal supply depot to the inland drilling summit convoy.
TRV-CONVOY-CYQ：For the Hercules Dome Deep Skiway Architecture, the overland traverse voyage plan specifies a caterpillar traverse payload of 85 t for transporting heavy drill components and bulk casing from the coastal supply depot to the inland drilling summit convoy across the continental ice route.
TRV-CONVOY-R85：For the Dome C East Overland Traverse Architecture, the overland traverse voyage plan establishes a caterpillar traverse payload of 70 t for heavy drill components and bulk casing hauled along the continental ice route from the coastal supply depot to the inland drilling summit convoy.
